## Performance Tiers

| Tier | Score Range | Label | Selection Modifier |
|------|-------------|-------|--------------------|
| S | 50 to 100 | Elite | 2x selection weight |
| A | 20 to 49 | Strong | 1.5x selection weight |
| B | -19 to 19 | Standard | 1x selection weight (default) |
| C | -49 to -20 | Struggling | 0.75x selection weight |
| D | -100 to -50 | Critical | 0.5x selection weight |
